missing_results.description: Almost-sure convergence: (Gmax − G_Exp3.P.1)/sqrt(T ln T f(T)) → 0 with probability 1 for any f → ∞.
missing_results.quote: For any K ≥ 2 and for any function f : R → R with lim_{T→∞} f(T) = ∞, lim_{T→∞} (Gmax − GExp3.P.1)/sqrt(T (ln T) f(T)) = 0 holds for any assignment of rewards with probability 1.

summary: The extraction is accurate overall: the constants, conditions, horizons and registry ids match the paper for nearly all results. There is one critical error: Theorem 9.1's bound is on average per-round regret and was not multiplied by T. There is also one major error: the expert-advice setting does not record N_exp as known to the learner. Corollary 6.5 (almost-sure convergence) is not recorded; it is a limit statement and hard to write as a closed expression.
